messages:
maya: Morning — quick async standup from me.

maya: What I did: landed the microkernel slot-steal mitigation (commit f2d9c3a), tightened batch_coalesce for small requests, and added an opt-in prefetch shim for model shards.

maya: Blockers: seeing a small p95 regression on 8k context workloads on A100 canaries (~+6–8ms). suspicious about KV eviction churn when bursty small requests interleave with long sequences.

maya: Today: iterate on eviction heuristic, run 1h steady-state perf with KV load, and coordinate canary with jin. Leaving PR for review: #384.

leo: taking a look at #384 now. quick ask — can you paste the bench cmd and relevant env vars you used?

maya: bench command I used: `bench perf --model redwood-v1 --seq 8192 --batch 16 --threads 4 --kv-load 0.2`

maya: env snippets:
```
BATCH_COALESCE=6
KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.32
PREFETCH_ENABLED=true
```

jin: pinged ops to spin a dedicated canary cluster (kernel-canary-3). will run the same bench and attach logs. @ops-bot can you start the canary and post the link?

ops-bot: Canary deploy requested: cluster=kernel-canary-3, image=runtime:v2026-04-18-f2d9c3a. ETA ~12m. Link: https://deploys.internal/canary/kernel-canary-3

sam: quick KV note: noticed eviction spikes when microbursting small requests while long seqs have hot KV. lowered `KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD` from 0.4 -> 0.32 on a local replica and saw eviction rate drop ~45%. will push a small experiment config in the repo.

devin: I reviewed #384 — left a comment about a potential race in the prefetch token queue on line 218, worth a tiny guard. otherwise LGTM.

leo: bench results from my run on a single A100 (local repro): baseline (main): p50 18ms p95 42ms p99 78ms. with f2d9c3a + coalesce=6: p50 16ms p95 36ms p99 70ms. KV eviction count dropped ~30% during steady-state.

maya: great, thanks leo. that matches my numbers-ish. jin, let us know the canary numbers when ready and include memory/KV metrics.

jin: canary started — first pass (short 5-min run) shows p95 ~38ms, p99 still noisy at 71ms. collecting full logs and will run 1h steady-state next. posting link when complete.

ops-bot: Canary run logs: https://logs.internal/canary/kernel-canary-3/run-001 (parsed summary will be available in ~45m).

maya: blockers update: none critical for rollout, but want to watch p99 for the next 2 canary windows. if p99 stays high we'll roll back the prefetch and only keep the slot-steal mitigation.

devin: no blockers from infra side. I'll tidy the guard in the prefetch queue and push a tiny test.

sam: I'll prepare a brief perf dash tile for KV eviction vs p95 so we can watch the trend across canaries.

maya: thanks — last TODO: after the 1h run, we'll decide canary -> gradual rollout or revert prefetch. tagging the thread with follow-ups. :thumbsup:

leo: acked.

jin: will post final numbers by +45m.

ops-bot: Canary steady-state run complete: summary pending.

maya: done for now — ping me if anything spikes.
